1.w: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, [keep] no silence to You; do not be silent, and do not be still, O God.

2.w: For behold, Your enemies roar, and those hating You have lifted up the head.

3.w: Against Your people, they act with cunning counsel, and they take counsel together against Your treasured ones.

4.w: They say, “Come, and we shall make them disappear as a nation, and the name of Israel will not be remembered anymore.”

5.w: For, they consulted together in heart; they cut an alliance against You—

6.w: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,

7.w: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia with those dwelling [in] Tyre.

8.w: Assyria also has joined with them; they have become an arm for the sons of Lot. Selah

9.w: may You do to them as [to] Midian, as [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin, at the River Kishon.

10.w: They perished at Endor; they became dung for the earth!

11.w: Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb, and like Zebah, and like Zalmunna—all their princes—

12.w: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”

13.w: O my God, set them like the whirling dust, like chaff before the face of the wind!

14.w: As the fire burns a forest, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire,

15.w: so may You pursue them with Your tempest and terrify them with Your storm.

16.w: Fill their faces [with] shame, and they shall seek Your name, O YHWH.

17.w: Let them be put to shame and dismayed until forever, and may they be ashamed and perish!

18.w: And they shall know that You—Your name [is] YHWH—You alone [are] Most High over all the earth!
